description: Price of a plain fixed-rate bond on a coupon date, with Macaulay duration, modified duration, convexity and DV01. Price = sum of the coupons and the face value discounted at the yield per period (yield / frequency), clean price, no accrued interest, so years x frequency must be a whole number of coupon periods. The yield is the nominal yearly yield to maturity compounded frequency times a year (the bond-market convention). Durations are in years, convexity in years squared. DV01 is the price fall for one basis point of yield, a positive number, the slope at the current yield and not a repricing. It does not include credit risk, call features, taxes or the day-count of a real settlement date. Edge cases: faceValue above zero and at most 1e12 (default 1000); couponRate 0 to 1 as a fraction; yieldRate -1 to 100 with the rate per period above -100%; years above zero and at most 100; frequency a whole number 1 to 12 (default 2); years times frequency must be a whole number of coupon periods. Not covered: accrued interest and a settlement date between coupons, credit risk, call and put features, floating coupons, taxes, and the day-count convention. Use when user asks "what is a 5-year 5% coupon bond worth at a 6% yield?" or "what is the duration and DV01 of this bond?". Returns: price, pricePctOfFace, status (premium, par, discount), pvOfCoupons, pvOfFace, couponPerPeriod, periods, yieldPerPeriod, currentYield, macaulayDuration, modifiedDuration, convexity, dv01.

couponRate.description: Annual coupon rate as a fraction of face value (0.05 = 5%), 0 to 1; 0 is a zero-coupon bond

faceValue.description: Face (par) value repaid at maturity, above 0 (default 1000)

frequency.description: Coupon payments a year, 1 to 12 (default 2: semiannual; 1 annual, 4 quarterly, 12 monthly)

years.description: Years to maturity, above 0 and at most 100; years x frequency must be a whole number (5 years semiannual is 10 coupons)

yieldRate.description: Nominal yearly yield to maturity as a fraction (0.06 = 6%), compounded frequency times a year; yield / frequency must be above -1
